body_text:
Axiom of choice. For every set $I$ and every family $(A_i)_{i\in I}$
of nonempty sets, there exists a function $f$ on $I$ such that
$f(i)\in A_i$ for every $i\in I$. The assertion is substantive when
the family is infinite and no canonical rule for choosing the
elements is available. ZF together with this axiom is denoted ZFC.
